entries.en: to pass away; to depart this life

entries.zh: 归仙；去世（婉辞，谓归于仙乡）
entries.en: to die; to return to the immortals (euphemism)
to die; to depart this world

entries.zh: 沦没；沉沦消亡，死亡（西语 acabarse：终结、消亡）
entries.en: to perish; to sink away and die; to come to an end
to perish; to be lost or annihilated

entries.zh: 死心；向世俗而死、弃绝尘世（宗教语）；引申为断绝念想
entries.en: to die to the world; to renounce worldly things; (fig.) to give up all hope
entries.notes: 死心 本义为断念，此处依西语 morir al mundo（向世俗而死）的宗教语境取义。

entries.zh: 绝气；气绝身亡（生命之线断绝）
entries.en: to breathe one's last; to die (the thread of life is cut)

entries.zh: 短行；寿数短促，因忧苦悲伤而早亡
entries.en: to die of grief; to die young, short-lived
entries.notes: 短行 罕见（行 指行年寿数），释义依 source_L「morir de pena」推定为因悲苦早亡。

entries.en: to breathe one's last; to give up the ghost
to starve to death; a person starved to death

entries.zh: 无老相；未及年老而死，早逝
entries.en: to die young; to die before reaching old age
entries.notes: 無老相 为闽南口语婉辞，字面「无老态」，据 source_L「morir moço」定为未老而亡。

entries.zh: 命无根；病危将死（谓性命无所依托）
entries.en: to be dying of illness; mortally ill (life without a root)
entries.notes: source_L 原作 morira della enfermedad（= morirá de la enfermedad），H 栏「命無根」为比喻说法，义据二者合推。

entries.en: to lose one's life; to perish

entries.zh: 米饭；煮熟的白饭（西语 morisqueta，马尼拉西班牙语指米饭）
entries.en: cooked rice; boiled rice (Philippine Spanish morisqueta)

entries.zh: 烂饭；煮得极软烂的米饭
entries.en: very soft overcooked rice; mushy rice

entries.zh: 头盔；一种铁盔（西语 morrión／celada）
entries.en: morion; a kind of helmet (celada: sallet)
entries.notes: 汉字栏作「矛」且标〔疑：矛/弓〕，与西语「头盔」义不合，疑为字形误识；义以 source_L 为据。
汉字作「鉄頭茅」，「茅」疑为「帽」之讹；首音节音标 T99 污损；义据 source_L morrión（头盔）定。
